imageGeneration.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: educational bitmap illustration for a Korean research news article, landscape 3:2. Create a clean, elegant textbook cutaway illustration explaining a wearable-to-implant resonant wireless power system to a middle-school reader. White/cream background, navy blue transmitter and green receiver. Left: a simple wearable external coil above a simplified horizontal skin layer, a soft flexible spiral receiver directly below skin, with a small electronics chip and two short leads. Middle: two translucent blue curved arrows indicate magnetic coupling from external coil to implanted receiver; no ray beam. Right: a magnified smooth flexible liquid-metal conductive trace inside transparent elastic material, gently stretched, plus a small feedback-loop icon next to the transmitter indicating adaptive oscillation. Layout three distinct illustrated zones with generous empty space and clear visual hierarchy. Make this overtly a conceptual illustration, not a photograph, not an actual device design and not a reproduction of a paper figure. Absolutely no measured plot, ECG, human/animal surgical photograph, realistic commercial device, fabricated dimensions, numbers, logos, or equations. Only these four short Korean text labels in legible large type, verbatim: '몸 밖 송신기', '피부', '몸 안 수신기', '설명용 그림'. Do not show the implanted receiver as a tiny finished pacemaker; no device size claim. Scientific accuracy: energy crosses skin via resonant inductive magnetic coupling, power source stays outside, receiver supplies electronics inside. Restrained JJo editorial palette #1F4E78, #D9EAF7, #315E51, #F3EFE4.
imageGeneration.verified: Visually reviewed; Korean labels legible. Conceptual illustration, no measurement claim.
